scope: Bounded source review and executable crypto/envelope regressions, not a full security certification
reviewer_boundary: Read-only source/primary-source review and ephemeral in-memory probes; no independent full-suite execution

resolved_findings.finding: Stock direct JWE accepts a nonempty unused encrypted-key segment while ciphertext/tag still validate
resolved_findings.impact_boundary: Strict-format/wire malleability, not evidence of changed authenticated claims

resolved_findings.finding: Raw RSA encoding comparison can miss identical key material represented with padded exponent bytes and different key IDs
resolved_findings.resolution: Bounded unsigned-integer modulus/exponent comparison for signing/decryption key separation
resolved_findings.coverage: Local public/JWK/raw-RSA and metadata callback regressions

resolved_findings.finding: Normal metadata JWK conversion can produce a padded RsaSecurityKey whose KeySize overstates actual modulus bits
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate actual bounded RSA public material on converted/raw RSA paths, with named-curve checks for raw EC
resolved_findings.coverage: Real JsonWebKeySet.GetSigningKeys conversion plus Signed and EncryptedSigned validator paths

verified_boundaries: EncryptedSigned rejects plaintext downgrade and Signed rejects encrypted credentials
Outer key-management gate is separate from content enc/derived CEK and inner-signature validation roles
Exactly one encrypted layer followed by a signed unencrypted JWT on successful validation
Pinned base string overload dispatches through the derived SecurityToken overload; actual runtime probe observed one override call
Duplicate/unknown/critical/compression/remote-reference header controls are enforced before standard crypto
root_execution: Exact committed full suites passed 723 Windows / 720 WSL; Jwe.ContractTests55/55 per host
limitations: Outer duplicate-header execution case has an invalid MAC, so successful-MAC outer duplicate rejection is source-inspection evidence; the inner duplicate case is signed and re-encrypted. Initial .NET10 reviewer probes corroborate library behavior but do not replace pinned SDK11 final runs. No timing-oracle, real KMS/HSM/IdP lifecycle or production claim.
